name: procurement_quote
description: Extract only the complete, explicitly supplier-confirmed final quotation. Preserve the first comparable unit price and the final unit price. Never infer missing amounts or confirmation. Use the same fields as submit_procurement_quote.

initial_price.description: First confirmed comparable unit price in BRL; strictly positive.

final_price.description: Last confirmed unit price in BRL, including zero if explicitly offered.

shipping_fee.description: Confirmed shipping fee in BRL; "0.00" if free or included.

fees.description: Confirmed additional taxes/fees in BRL; "0.00" if none or included.

lead_days.description: Confirmed delivery lead time in integer days (>= 0).

qty.description: Available quantity confirmed by the supplier.

delivery_time.description: Confirmed deadline and starting point, or explicit calendar date.

conditions.description: Confirmed payment, freight and tax conditions; explicitly describe any changes.

product_confirmed.description: True after confirming the product matches the request.

destination_confirmed.description: True after confirming delivery to the requested destination/CEP.

supplier_confirmed.description: True when the supplier explicitly confirms closing the quotation on the call.
